{"content":[{"type":"text","text":"Fine-knit top: fitted merino sweater with a soft crew neck, long sleeves, hip length, dusty blue #7fa6c8, merino wool

Skirt: A-line midi with a defined waist, mid-calf length, deep navy #1f2a44, wool crepe

Jacket: single-breasted textured blazer, slightly fitted, hip length, grey-blue #5a6478, bouclé tweed

Coat: single-breasted straight coat, knee length, deep plum #5e2f45, brushed wool

Tights: sheer matte, charcoal #3a3d45, fine nylon

Ankle boots: sleek pointed toe, 5 cm block heel, black #1c1c1f, smooth leather

Clutch: small structured envelope clutch with a thin chain strap, black #1c1c1f, leather

Earrings: slim drop earrings, silver #c0c4cc, polished metal

This outfit sits right in the neat band for an evening at the theatre: a refined knit, a skirt and a textured jacket, with ankle boots that are comfortable through a long performance. The dusty blue knit echoes her eye color and the cool silver of her hair, while the navy skirt grounds the look. The plum coat adds depth and warmth for an autumn evening and comes off easily in the cloakroom.
